text:
Ava: Quick sync — proposal: split MVP launch into two tranches to unblock customers who only need embeddings/reranking. We can ship tranche A (embeddings + basic rerank) in ~3 weeks, tranche B (conversation + tool-calls) in ~7 weeks. Thoughts? @Marco @Priya

Marco: OK on concept. Main risk is embeddings infra — dedupe cache and batching need work. If we prioritize A, ETA is 2.5w for infra changes + 3d for API hardening.

Priya: I'll rebase the release calendar and update the roadmap board. Quick Q — is SLA for tranche A the same as full product? Some customers expect <200ms p95.

Dan: Metrics team can run a perf baseline for embeddings. Need access to a representative customer dataset (anonymized). @Ava can you confirm privacy/consent for those datasets?

Zoe: Design can slice the conversation UX for tranche B; recommend deferring role-based flows and rich attachments to B. For A we can ship a minimal results list + explainers.

Marco: If we deliver A as a non-streaming API we can avoid big KV cache changes now. That saves ~1.5w of infra work but will raise token cost and might hurt p95. Flagging tradeoff to product.

Ava: Good tradeoff callout. Decision options: (1) Single release with scope cut, (2) Tranches A/B. I prefer tranches to de-risk and get revenue motion earlier. :thumbsup: to approve moves us forward.

Priya: Approve for tranches. I'll create a canary plan: start A with 3 pilot customers -> evaluate SLA & cost -> ramp to wider accounts.

Ava: Action items: Marco = list engineering cuts + blockers in the ticket; Dan = schedule perf baseline; Zoe = prepare trimmed UX flows; Priya = update roadmap + canary plan and notify sales. I'll tag owners in the main ticket. Proposed timelines: Tranche A target 2026-04-12, Tranche B target 2026-05-24.

Marco: Quick question — do we pin Tranche A to model v1.3-quant or leave model flexible? Pinning helps perf reproducibility but makes rollouts heavier.

Ava: For risk containment, pin Tranche A to v1.3-quant. Tranche B can iterate on model variants. We'll document rollback/compat criteria.

Priya: Scheduling stakeholder sync for Friday 10:00am PT. Agenda: gating criteria, canary success metrics (p95 latency, token cost delta, recall delta), and open blockers.

Zoe: I'll mock 3 reduced screens and share by EOD tomorrow.

Dan: Baseline perf run scheduled tomorrow 2:00pm PT — will include token costs, latency p95/p99, and throughput.

Marco: Adding an engineering spike ticket to evaluate KV-cache bypass path for A (estimate 2d). Will put notes on perf/cost tradeoffs in the ticket.

Ava: Great. If anyone has objections before Friday call, speak up now. Otherwise moving forward with Tranche A/B approach. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Reminder — please create a release branch and canary checklist when Tranche A is code-complete.
